block.guhs.guhmon_badgedoos.lore: Room for eight gym badges. Click it with a badge. The other five gyms are closed for a nap.
item.guhs.guhmon_badge_dutjes.lore: From Gym Leader Naps, because your guh fell asleep first.
item.guhs.guhmon_badge_njeg.lore: For ruining a Nap with a well-timed Nyeg.
item.guhs.guhmon_badge_knabbel.lore: For falling asleep on a full tummy.
block.guhs.bzg_brievenbus.lore: From the studio of Farmer Wants a Guh. At home it never has any mail, nyeg.
block.guhs.bzg_ingelijste_brief.lore: Farmer Guhrrit's thank-you note. Click to read.
subtitles.guhs.bzg.tune: The Farmer Wants a Guh theme
gui.guhs.guhmon.grap.uitleg: Challenge Gym Leader Naps with one of your own guhs. No HP, just a SLEEP bar: whoever falls asleep first wins.
gui.guhs.guhmon.grap.stap.1: Walk into the gym and challenge Gym Leader Naps
gui.guhs.guhmon.grap.stap.3: Fall asleep before the opponent does
quest.guhs.guhmon.lobby.hallo: Yaaawn... Oh, a challenger! I'm Gym Leader Naps. In my gym guhs don't battle with bonks, they battle with naps. Whoever falls asleep first wins. Do you dare, nyeg?
quest.guhs.guhmon.lobby.weer: The champion is back! My Snorkel has been training extra hard. Yesterday he slept nineteen hours. Another round?
quest.guhs.guhmon.lobby.uitleg: You pick one of your tamed guhs. A copy appears in the gym, the real one stays comfy at home. No guh? Then you get a loaner guh. Four moves: Chonk, Nyeg, Eat Nibble and Nap. Nothing hurts. Losing costs nothing: just try again.
quest.guhs.guhmon.optie.uitleg: How does a Guhmon Battle work?
quest.guhs.guhmon.kwijt.hier: Gym Leader Naps had a spare under his pillow.
quest.guhs.guhmon.kwijt.niets: You still have everything on you, nyeg. Check your pockets.
quest.guhs.guhmon.gym.welkom: Welcome to the Nap Gym! Shh, the audience is asleep already. Step on the mat or give me a tap when you're ready.
quest.guhs.guhmon.gym.gewonnen: Unbelievable... %s fell asleep before my Snorkel! Nobody has ever done that. Today, I mean. Here, the Nap Badge is yours!
gui.guhs.guhmon.kies.niet_van_jou: I don't know that guh, nyeg. Pick one of your own.
gui.guhs.guhmon.publiek.slaapt: Shh! The audience is asleep. As it should be.
gui.guhs.guhmon.publiek.wakker: Snorkel gives you a sleepy look.
gui.guhs.guhmon.badgedoos.zit_er_al: That badge is in there already, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhmon.badgedoos.stand: %s of 8 badges. The other gyms are closed for a nap.
gui.guhs.guhmon.gids.badge.dutjes: Win the battle against Gym Leader Naps.
gui.guhs.guhmon.gids.badge.njeg: Win a battle in which your Nyeg made one of Snorkel's Naps fail.
gui.guhs.guhmon.gids.badge.knabbel: Fall asleep while your tummy is still full from Eat Nibble.
gui.guhs.guhmon.kies.uitleg: A copy appears in the gym: your real guh stays comfy at home. The gym's loaner guh is at the bottom.
gui.guhs.guhmon.kies.geen_eigen: You have no tamed guhs yet. No worries: the gym lends you one. Its name is Loaner Guh.
gui.guhs.guhmon.zet.vadsen.tip: +25 sleep for your own guh. Just lying there.
gui.guhs.guhmon.zet.njeg.tip: -15 sleep for the opponent. Not very effective, but its next Nap fails.
gui.guhs.guhmon.zet.knabbel.tip: +10 sleep now, and +10 for two more turns from a full tummy.
gui.guhs.guhmon.zet.dutje.tip: +40 sleep! Fails if the opponent just said Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhmon.scherm.dicht: The battle is waiting for you. Tap Gym Leader Naps to go on.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.intro.1: Gym Leader Naps wants to battle! Well, battle...
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.intro.2: Gym Leader Naps sends out %s! It looks a little drowsy already...
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.intro.3: Go, %s! Whoever falls asleep first wins.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.njeg: %s uses Nyeg! It's not very effective... %s wakes up a little.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.knabbel: %s uses Eat Nibble! Its tummy is full.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.knabbel_vol: %s eats another nibble! Its tummy was full already, but there's always room for one more.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.dutje: %s uses Nap! Zzz... It's super effective!
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.dutje_mislukt: %s uses Nap... but that Nyeg is still echoing! It fails.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.buikje: %s gets sleepy from its full tummy.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.gewonnen: %s fell asleep first. You win the battle!
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.verloren: %s fell asleep first. Gym Leader Naps wins... But %s can simply try again.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.na_winst: Your guh snores happily. Gym Leader Naps looks for the badge under his pillow.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.na_verlies: No worries, nyeg! Losing costs nothing. Wake your guh up and try again.
gui.guhs.guhmon.tekst.let_op: Careful: the Nyeg is still echoing. A Nap fails now.
gui.guhs.bzg.grap.uitleg: Host Guhvon's TV show. Farmer Guhrrit is looking for a guh to nap with. You lend a paw.
gui.guhs.bzg.grap.stap.1: Talk to Host Guhvon: the show is starting
gui.guhs.bzg.grap.stap.2: Take the three letters out of the mailbox and read them
gui.guhs.bzg.grap.stap.3: The stay-over week: tuck everybody in at the farm
gui.guhs.bzg.grap.stap.4: The choice: help Farmer Guhrrit choose
quest.guhs.bzg.lobby.hallo: Hello, dear viewers! I'm Guhvon, and this is Farmer Wants a Guh. Farmer Guhrrit is looking for somebody to nap with in the hay. Three letters came in. Will you help with the recording?
quest.guhs.bzg.lobby.weer: There you are again! The rerun of your episode was a ratings hit. Especially the part where nobody did anything. Record it again?
quest.guhs.bzg.lobby.uitleg: You read the letters, you help during the stay-over week and you stand by Farmer Guhrrit when he has to choose. It's only television, nyeg: after the credits it's over.
quest.guhs.bzg.optie.uitleg: What do I have to do?
quest.guhs.bzg.optie.kwijt: I lost my framed letter, nyeg
quest.guhs.bzg.kwijt.hier: Guhvon had another copy of the letter in her bag.
quest.guhs.bzg.kwijt.niets: You still have everything on you, nyeg. Check your pockets.
quest.guhs.bzg.boer.los: I really belong on the farm. The hay is softer there.
quest.guhs.bzg.boer.vroeg: Shh, the cameras aren't rolling yet. I'm practicing my surprised face.
quest.guhs.bzg.boer.wakker: Yaaawn... What a week! I missed all of it, but it was lovely. And now I have to choose? Help me out, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bzg.studio.welkom: And... action! Welcome to the studio. Come stand next to me and we'll begin.
quest.guhs.bzg.studio.brieven: The mailbox is over there, by the sofa. Read all three letters, okay!
quest.guhs.bzg.studio.logeren: The stay-over week has begun! Walk through the set to the farm. Everybody is asleep already. Go tuck them in.
quest.guhs.bzg.studio.keuze: So exciting! Farmer Guhrrit has to choose. Go help him.
quest.guhs.bzg.studio.samen: Shh. They're asleep. This is the most beautiful television I have ever made.
quest.guhs.bzg.intro.1: Dear viewers, welcome to a brand-new season of Farmer Wants a Guh!
quest.guhs.bzg.intro.2: This year: Farmer Guhrrit. He has a farm, a straw hat and a whole lot of hay. The only thing missing is somebody to snore next to.
quest.guhs.bzg.intro.3: We got piles of letters! Well, three. The candidates are on the sofa already. Give them a wave.
quest.guhs.bzg.intro.4: Would you take the letters out of the mailbox and read them? I lost my reading glasses, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bzg.kandidaat.hoi.1: Hi! I came all the way from the city. I took a nap on the train to warm up.
quest.guhs.bzg.kandidaat.hoi.2: Hello... Is that real hay over there? I've been dreaming about it for weeks.
quest.guhs.bzg.kandidaat.hoi.3: Good day. I snore in three keys. It's in my letter, too.
quest.guhs.bzg.keuze.vraag: Snoozie, Dozeline or Snorebert... All three of them slept so beautifully. Who should I choose, nyeg?
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.twijfel: %s? Yes... But what about the other two? They look so sweet lying there. I can't, nyeg. I can't choose!
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.allemaal: All of them? Is that allowed? I bet that's not in the script... But I couldn't choose anyway, nyeg!
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.2: You know what? The hay is big enough. All three of you just stay. As friends. Nap friends.
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.3: WAHOOG! Can I have the spot by the window, then?
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.4: Dear viewers, we have never seen this before: everybody wins and everybody sleeps. See you next season!
gui.guhs.bzg.brievenbus.leeg.2: Just a flyer from the Travel Agency.
gui.guhs.bzg.brievenbus.leeg.3: There's a crumb in it. That's all.
gui.guhs.bzg.brievenbus.leeg.4: Empty. The mail guh is still asleep.
gui.guhs.bzg.brieven.nog: %s of %s letters read. Read all three, nyeg.
gui.guhs.bzg.logeerweek.onder: Everybody is asleep already. Tuck them in.
gui.guhs.bzg.keuze.onder: Farmer Guhrrit is awake. Go talk to him.
gui.guhs.bzg.ingestopt: Day %s of the stay-over week: %s is all tucked in.
book.guhs.bzg.brief.1.tekst: I'm Snoozie and I live in the city. It's busy and noisy there, so I only sleep in until nine in the morning. My hobbies are afternoon naps, morning naps and going for walks (to my basket). I heard the countryside is so quiet you can hear yourself yawn. That sounds lovely. I can also sleep standing up, by the way, which is handy for milking.
book.guhs.bzg.brief.2.tekst: My name is Dozeline. Ever since I was a tiny guh I have dreamed of lying in real hay. At home I only have a pillow, and it's just not the same. I'm very caring: when you sleep, I'll happily sleep along. I love long conversations, as long as they don't take too long. I can't cook, but I can look at cheese nibbles very sweetly until somebody gives them to me.
book.guhs.bzg.brief.2.groet: Lots of love and good night, Dozeline
book.guhs.bzg.brief.3.tekst: I, Snorebert, hereby apply for the position of your guh. I have eleven years of experience in sleeping and I snore in three keys. References are available on request, but they're asleep right now. My strengths: lying down, sitting, and lying down. My weakness: getting up. I am available immediately, unless I happen to be asleep. I look forward to hearing from you, preferably after nap time.
book.guhs.bzg.bedankbrief.tekst: Thank you for your help with the show. Snoozie, Dozeline and Snorebert all live on the farm now. We get up early every day, around eleven, and then we lie down again right away. The cows more or less milk themselves. The hay has never been this flat. Do drop by sometime, but knock softly: somebody is always asleep. You tucked us in so nicely back then, nyeg.
book.guhs.bzg.bedankbrief.groet: A big hug from Farmer Guhrrit (and the rest, who are asleep)
gui.guhs.bzg.aftiteling.naam.5: a guh that leaned on it by accident
gui.guhs.bzg.aftiteling.naam.8: cheese nibbles (gone before the first take)
gui.guhs.bzg.aftiteling.naam.10: every guh that stayed awake until the credits
gui.guhs.bzg.aftiteling.naam.11: not a single nap was interrupted
